summary: Quality concerns about generated images, questioning model choices
detailed_context: Ivan is dissatisfied with the quality of recently generated images compared to previous articles. He's asking two things: (1) Which models are being used in BrigadePipeline.ts and (2) whether the advanced models they tested earlier are actually being utilized, or if there's a fallback to a 'skill art' customization. He expresses frustration by calling the current output 'какое-то г' (garbage/shit), indicating the images don't meet his quality expectations. Ivan provided screenshots as evidence of the quality problem. The root cause is a gap between expected (advanced models, high quality) and actual (lower quality output). This reveals Ivan expects consistent, high-quality image generation and wants transparency about which models are running. He may suspect Navi or the system downgraded to cheaper/weaker models without notification.
